the.zh: 這個、那個（定冠詞，指特定的人事物）
ai: Please close the door when you leave the room.
離開房間時請把門關上。
The book on the table is mine.
桌上的那本書是我的。
We saw the sun rise over the mountains.
我們看見太陽從山後升起。
I bought bread and milk at the store.
我在店裡買了麵包和牛奶。
She opened the window and let in some fresh air.
她打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。
It was cold and rainy all weekend.
整個週末又冷又下雨。
This is a photo of my family.
這是一張我家人的照片。
The color of the sky changed at sunset.
天空的顏色在日落時改變了。
She is a good friend of mine.
她是我的一位好朋友。
I lost my phone, but I found it under the sofa.
我弄丟了手機，不過在沙發底下找到了它。
She asked me about the test, and I told her it was easy.
她問我考試的事，我說那很簡單。

it.zh: （虛主詞，指天氣、時間、距離等，通常不翻譯）
ai: It is raining hard, so take an umbrella.
雨下得很大，所以帶把傘吧。
It takes about twenty minutes to walk to the station.
走到車站大約要二十分鐘。
It is already ten o'clock at night.
已經是晚上十點了。
I usually get up at seven every morning.
我通常每天早上七點起床。
Can you tell me where I can buy a ticket?
你可以告訴我哪裡能買票嗎？
Yesterday I met an old friend on the street.
昨天我在街上遇到一位老朋友。
I made a cup of tea for you.
我幫你泡了一杯茶。
We saved money for a trip to Japan.
我們為了去日本旅行而存錢。

for.zh: 持續（一段時間，for two years 兩年之久）
ai: He has lived in this city for two years.
他已經在這座城市住了兩年。
We waited for an hour before the bus came.
我們等了一個小時公車才來。
She did not go out, for it was raining heavily.
她沒有出門，因為雨下得很大。
He felt tired, for he had worked all night.
他覺得很累，因為他整晚都在工作。
Do you want some more water?
你還想要一點水嗎？
Thank you for helping me with my homework.
謝謝你幫我寫功課。
I will see you all at the party tomorrow.
明天派對上再見啦，各位。
I went to the movies with my sister.
我和姊姊一起去看電影。
Would you like to have lunch with us?
你要不要跟我們一起吃午餐？
She cut the cake with a sharp knife.
她用一把鋒利的刀切蛋糕。
You can pay with cash or a credit card.
你可以用現金或信用卡付款。

with.zh: 有、帶著（a girl with long hair）
ai: The girl with long hair is my classmate.
那個留著長髮的女孩是我的同學。
He walked into the room with a big smile.
他帶著大大的笑容走進房間。
They are waiting for us outside the cinema.
他們在電影院外面等我們。
My neighbors are nice, and they always say hello.
我的鄰居人很好，他們總是會打招呼。
I like these shoes because they are very comfortable.
我喜歡這雙鞋，因為它們非常舒服。
She works at a small bookstore near the park.
她在公園附近的一家小書店工作。
I asked my mother where she put the keys.
我問媽媽她把鑰匙放在哪裡。
She is learning how to play the piano.
她正在學彈鋼琴。
We will meet at the train station at six.
我們六點在火車站見面。
He is very good at solving math problems.
他很擅長解數學題。
Don't shout at the children.
不要對孩子們大吼大叫。
We are going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
這個週末我們要去探望祖父母。
If we leave now, we can catch the last bus.
如果現在出發，我們就趕得上末班車。
We have been friends since we were kids.
我們從小就是朋友。
He forgot his umbrella on the bus.
他把雨傘忘在公車上了。
Tom is cleaning his room right now.
湯姆現在正在打掃他的房間。
The dog wagged its tail when it saw his father.
小狗一看到他的爸爸就搖起尾巴。
She walked home from school.
她從學校走路回家。
My cousin is from Canada.
我的表哥來自加拿大。
From what I heard, the shop will close next month.
根據我聽到的消息，這家店下個月要關了。
Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
你比較喜歡哪個，茶還是咖啡？
Which of these bags is yours?
這些袋子裡哪一個是你的？

which.zh: （關係代名詞）指前面提到的事物
ai: This is the book which I told you about.
這就是我跟你說過的那本書。
He lost his phone, which made him very upset.
他弄丟了手機，這讓他非常沮喪。
Would you like tea or coffee?
你想喝茶還是咖啡？
You can take the bus or ride a bike to work.
你可以搭公車或騎腳踏車去上班。
Hurry up, or we will miss the train.
快一點，否則我們會趕不上火車。

an.zh: 一（用在母音開頭的字前）
ai: I ate an apple after dinner.
晚餐後我吃了一顆蘋果。
She waited for an hour outside the shop.
她在店外等了一個小時。
He is an honest man who always tells the truth.
他是個誠實的人，總是說實話。

would.zh: 會（假設語氣，will 的過去式）
ai: If I had more time, I would learn another language.
如果我有更多時間，我會學另一種語言。
She said she would call me after the meeting.
她說開完會後會打給我。
I would like a glass of water, please.
請給我一杯水。
Would you like to sit by the window?
你想坐靠窗的位子嗎？
When I was a child, we would visit the beach every summer.
我小時候，我們每年夏天都會去海邊。
He would read a story to me before I went to sleep.
他以前常在我睡前念故事給我聽。
The students put their bags on the floor.
學生們把書包放在地上。
My neighbors painted their house blue last year.
我的鄰居去年把他們的房子漆成藍色。
The birds built their nest in a tall tree.
鳥兒在一棵高樹上築了牠們的巢。
Who is knocking on the door?
是誰在敲門？
I don't know who left this bag here.
我不知道是誰把這個袋子留在這裡的。

who.zh: …的人（關係代名詞，如 the man who called）
ai: The woman who lives next door is a nurse.
住在隔壁的那位女士是護理師。
I have a friend who plays the violin very well.
我有個朋友小提琴拉得很好。
I gave her a small gift for her birthday.
我送了她一份小禮物當作生日禮物。
She lost her wallet on the way home.
她在回家的路上弄丟了她的錢包。
Could you tell her that dinner is ready?
可以告訴她晚餐準備好了嗎？
My brother is older than me.
我的哥哥比我年長。
I left my keys on the kitchen table.
我把鑰匙放在廚房的桌上了。
Let me introduce my friend to you.
讓我向你介紹我的朋友。
When I was five, I could already ride a bike.
我五歲的時候就已經會騎腳踏車了。
She could not open the door because it was locked.
門鎖住了，所以她打不開。
It could rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。
That could be the reason he is late.
那也許就是他遲到的原因。

could.zh: 可以…嗎（客氣的請求：Could you help me?）
ai: Could you help me carry this box?
你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？
Could I borrow your pen for a moment?
我可以借一下你的筆嗎？
He put the letter into the envelope.
他把信放進信封裡。
The children ran into the house.
孩子們跑進了屋子裡。
The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.
毛毛蟲變成了蝴蝶。
The car ran into a tree by the road.
那輛車撞上了路邊的一棵樹。
My sister is really into jazz music these days.
我姊姊最近很迷爵士樂。
Are you into cooking or baking?
你喜歡煮菜還是烘焙？
The cat licked its paw.
那隻貓舔了舔牠的腳掌。
The company is proud of its new product.
這家公司為它的新產品感到驕傲。
The city is famous for its night markets.
這座城市以夜市聞名。
I invited them to my birthday party.
我邀請他們來參加我的生日派對。
These cookies smell great, so let's try them.
這些餅乾聞起來很香，我們來嚐嚐吧。
Please tell them that we will be a little late.
請告訴他們我們會晚一點到。
I have two brothers and one sister.
我有兩個哥哥（弟弟）和一個姊姊（妹妹）。
The meeting starts at two.
會議兩點開始。
Two of my friends are coming to dinner.
我有兩位朋友要來吃晚餐。
Please give me a moment to think.
請給我一點時間想一想。
He asked me to wait outside.
他要我在外面等。
Do you want to come with me?
你要跟我一起去嗎？
Is this your umbrella?
這是你的雨傘嗎？
Don't forget to bring your passport.
別忘了帶你的護照。
Thank you for sharing your ideas with us.
謝謝你們跟我們分享你們的想法。
I saw him at the bus stop this morning.
我今天早上在公車站看到他。
Can you send him the address by text?
你可以用簡訊把地址傳給他嗎？
Everyone likes him because he is so friendly.
大家都喜歡他，因為他非常友善。
She runs faster than I do.
她跑得比我快。
The test was easier than we expected.
這次考試比我們預期的簡單。
My brother is taller than me.
我哥哥比我高。
This bag is cheaper than that one.
這個包包比那個便宜。
These are my favorite shoes.
這些是我最喜歡的鞋子。
I bought these at the night market yesterday.
我昨天在夜市買了這些。
Are these your keys on the table?
桌上的這些是你的鑰匙嗎？
Our teacher gave us a lot of homework.
我們的老師給了我們很多功課。
We cleaned our room before the guests arrived.
客人到之前，我們把房間打掃乾淨了。
Our train leaves in ten minutes.
我們的火車十分鐘後出發。
You should drink more water every day.
你每天應該多喝水。
We should leave early to avoid the traffic.
我們應該早點出發以避開塞車。
The package should arrive by Friday.
包裹應該會在星期五前送到。
It should be sunny tomorrow, according to the forecast.
根據預報，明天應該會放晴。
I stayed home because I was sick.
我因為生病所以待在家裡。
She is happy because she passed the exam.
她很開心，因為她通過了考試。
Because it was late, we took a taxi home.
因為時間已晚，我們搭計程車回家。
The bank is between the post office and the library.
銀行在郵局和圖書館之間。
I usually have lunch between twelve and one.
我通常在十二點到一點之間吃午餐。
There is a big difference between these two phones.
這兩支手機之間有很大的差別。
Well, er, I'm not sure what to say.
嗯，呃，我不確定該說什麼。
It costs, er, about fifty dollars, I think.
那個要，呃，我想大概五十元。
He was rushed to the ER after the accident.
意外發生後，他被緊急送往急診室。
The ER was full of people on Saturday night.
星期六晚上急診室裡擠滿了人。
Those are my parents over there.
那邊那兩位是我的父母。
I don't like those, but I love these.
我不喜歡那些，但我很喜歡這些。
Those who work hard will be rewarded.
努力工作的人會得到回報。
I have three cats at home.
我家裡有三隻貓。
The movie starts in three minutes.
電影三分鐘後開始。
Three of us walked to the park together.
我們三個人一起走到公園。
Please come and join us for dinner.
請來和我們一起吃晚餐。
The teacher gave us some extra time.
老師多給了我們一些時間。
Can you show us the way to the station?
你可以告訴我們怎麼去車站嗎？

oh.zh: 喔、噢（表示驚訝、恍然大悟或回應）
ai: Oh, I see what you mean now.
喔，我現在懂你的意思了。
Oh no, I left my wallet at home!
糟糕，我把錢包忘在家裡了！
Oh, thank you so much for the gift.
噢，真的很謝謝你送的禮物。
Mr. Brown is our new math teacher.
布朗先生是我們新來的數學老師。
Good morning, Mr. Lee. How are you today?
早安，李先生。您今天好嗎？
Please give this letter to Mr. Wang.
請把這封信交給王先生。
I want to eat something sweet.
我想吃點甜的東西。
There is something in my shoe.
我的鞋子裡有東西。
Can I ask you something before you go?
你走之前我可以問你一件事嗎？

against.zh: 反對、違反（against the law 違法）
ai: Parking here is against the law.
在這裡停車是違法的。
Many people voted against the new plan.
很多人投票反對這個新計畫。
Our school played against a team from Taichung.
我們學校和一支台中的隊伍比賽。
The two countries fought against a common enemy.
兩國共同對抗同一個敵人。

against.zh: 靠著、貼著（lean against the wall）
ai: He leaned against the wall to rest.
他靠著牆休息。
Rain beat against the window all night.
雨整晚拍打著窗戶。
My neighbor is an American who teaches English.
我的鄰居是一位教英文的美國人。
Many Americans enjoy watching baseball in summer.
很多美國人夏天喜歡看棒球。
She bought an American car last year.
她去年買了一輛美國製的車。
I like American movies, especially comedies.
我喜歡美國電影，尤其是喜劇片。
There are four chairs around the table.
桌子周圍有四張椅子。
My sister is four years older than me.
我姊姊比我大四歲。
We waited at the station until four.
我們在車站一直等到四點。
I fell asleep during the movie.
我看電影時睡著了。
We visited many museums during our trip to Europe.
我們歐洲之行期間參觀了很多博物館。
Please keep quiet during the exam.
考試期間請保持安靜。
Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
雖然下著雨，我們還是出去散步了。
He kept working, although he was very tired.
儘管他很累，還是繼續工作。
Although the room was small, it felt warm and cozy.
雖然房間很小，卻讓人覺得溫暖舒適。
I usually wake up at five on Mondays.
我星期一通常五點起床。
She has lived here for five years.
她已經住在這裡五年了。
Please give me five minutes to finish.
請給我五分鐘讓我完成。
The city has more than two million people.
這座城市有超過兩百萬人口。
The company earned one million dollars last year.
這家公司去年賺了一百萬元。
Millions of people watched the game on TV.
數百萬人在電視上收看了這場比賽。
I have a million things to do today.
我今天有一大堆事情要做。
London is the capital of the United Kingdom.
倫敦是英國的首都。
The River Thames flows through London.
泰晤士河流經倫敦。
Many tourists visit London every summer.
每年夏天都有很多遊客造訪倫敦。

whether.zh: 是否、要不要（I don't know whether...）
ai: I don't know whether he will come to the party.
我不知道他會不會來參加派對。
She asked whether the store was open on Sundays.
她問這家店星期天有沒有營業。
We will go camping whether it rains or not.
不管會不會下雨，我們都要去露營。
Whether you agree or not, I'm going to try it.
不管你同不同意，我都要試試看。
The screen protector is only 0.3 mm thick.
這片螢幕保護貼只有零點三毫米厚。
It rained about 20 mm in one hour.
一個小時內下了大約二十毫米的雨。
Mm, this soup tastes really good.
嗯，這碗湯真好喝。
Mm, I think you are right.
嗯，我想你說得對。
John is a very common name in English-speaking countries.
約翰是英語系國家非常常見的名字。
John and his sister walk to school together.
約翰和他的妹妹一起走路上學。
Our new classmate's name is John.
我們的新同學叫約翰。
I waited at the station until midnight.
我在車站一直等到半夜。
The shop is open until nine every night.
這家店每晚營業到九點。
Stay here until I come back.
待在這裡，直到我回來。
She did not understand the joke until her friend explained it.
直到朋友解釋後，她才懂那個笑話。
She was standing among a group of tourists.
她站在一群觀光客當中。
Pizza is very popular among teenagers.
披薩在青少年之間非常受歡迎。
The house was hidden among tall trees.
那棟房子藏在高大的樹木之間。
He cut himself while cooking dinner.
他煮晚餐時不小心割到了自己。
The manager answered the phone himself.
經理親自接了電話。
Tom built the wooden table by himself.
湯姆自己一個人做了那張木桌。
There are six eggs in the box.
盒子裡有六顆蛋。
My train leaves at six in the morning.
我的火車早上六點開。
She started school when she was six.
她六歲時開始上學。
Is there anything I can do to help?
有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？
I didn't eat anything this morning.
我今天早上什麼都沒吃。
You can ask me anything about the trip.
關於這趟旅行，你什麼都可以問我。
The children ran towards the ice cream truck.
孩子們朝著冰淇淋車跑去。
She has a friendly attitude towards everyone.
她對每個人的態度都很友善。
We walked slowly towards the old bridge.
我們慢慢地走向那座老橋。
Some students like music, while others prefer sports.
有些學生喜歡音樂，有些則偏好運動。
You should think about the feelings of others.
你應該多為別人的感受著想。
Two of them stayed, and the others went home.
他們有兩人留下來，其他人都回家了。
Britain is an island country in northwest Europe.
英國是位於歐洲西北部的島國。
They traveled around Britain by train last summer.
他們去年夏天搭火車遊遍了英國。
Tea is a popular drink in Britain.
茶是英國很受歡迎的飲料。
Everything in this shop is on sale today.
這家店裡的所有東西今天都在特價。
Thank you for everything you have done for me.
謝謝你為我做的一切。
She packed everything into one small bag.
她把所有東西都塞進一個小包包裡。

themselves.zh: 他們自己、她們自己、它們自己
ai: The kids made lunch for themselves.
孩子們自己做了午餐。
They enjoyed themselves at the beach all afternoon.
他們整個下午在海邊玩得很開心。
The students themselves decided to clean the classroom.
學生們自己決定打掃教室。
The cat washed itself in the sun.
那隻貓在陽光下替自己洗毛。
The door closed by itself.
門自己關上了。
The idea itself is simple, but making it work is hard.
這個想法本身很簡單，但要實現卻很難。

upon.zh: 在…之上（on 的正式說法）
ai: Once upon a time, a king lived in a tall castle.
從前從前，有一位國王住在高高的城堡裡。
The cat sat upon the old wooden chair.
那隻貓坐在老舊的木椅上。
Upon arrival, please check in at the front desk.
一抵達，請先到櫃檯辦理登記。
Upon hearing the news, she burst into tears.
一聽到這個消息，她就哭了出來。
England is one of the countries in the United Kingdom.
英格蘭是英國的組成國之一。
London is the largest city in England.
倫敦是英格蘭最大的城市。
We spent our holiday in the south of England.
我們在英格蘭南部度過了假期。

mrs.zh: 太太、夫人（對已婚女子的稱呼）
ai: Mrs. Chen is my English teacher.
陳太太是我的英文老師。
Mr. and Mrs. Lin invited us to dinner.
林先生和林太太邀請我們吃晚餐。
Please send the package to Mrs. Wang.
請把包裹寄給王太太。
I have been waiting for ten minutes.
我已經等了十分鐘了。
There are ten students in my class.
我的班上有十個學生。
Count from one to ten slowly.
慢慢地從一數到十。
I shall return the book to you next week.
我下星期會把書還給你。
We shall never forget your kindness.
我們永遠不會忘記你的好意。
Shall we go for a walk after dinner?
晚餐後我們去散步好嗎？
Shall I open the window for you?
要不要我幫你把窗戶打開？
Whose umbrella is this on the chair?
椅子上這把雨傘是誰的？
I wonder whose idea it was to come here.
我在想來這裡是誰出的主意。
He is the man whose car was stolen last week.
他就是上星期車子被偷的那個人。
Many Europeans travel by train in summer.
很多歐洲人夏天搭火車旅行。
She is a European who now lives in Taipei.
她是一位現在住在台北的歐洲人。
We took a European tour last summer.
我們去年夏天參加了歐洲之旅。
Italy is a European country with a long history.
義大利是一個歷史悠久的歐洲國家。
Europe has many countries close to each other.
歐洲有許多彼此相鄰的國家。
She hopes to travel around Europe after graduation.
她希望畢業後能到歐洲各地旅行。
France and Germany are both in Europe.
法國和德國都在歐洲。
The UK includes England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
英國包括英格蘭、蘇格蘭、威爾士和北愛爾蘭。
My cousin is studying in the UK this year.
我表哥今年在英國念書。
Is it difficult to get a visa for the UK?
申請英國簽證很困難嗎？
There are seven days in a week.
一個星期有七天。
I get home at seven every evening.
我每天晚上七點到家。
The little boy is seven years old.
那個小男孩七歲了。
I sleep for about eight hours every night.
我每晚大約睡八個小時。
The shop opens at eight in the morning.
這家店早上八點開門。
There are eight people in her family.
她家裡有八個人。
She taught herself how to play the guitar.
她自學了彈吉他。
The teacher herself made all the cookies.
老師親自做了所有的餅乾。
My sister looked at herself in the mirror.
我姊姊看著鏡子裡的自己。
My uncle has been a Republican for many years.
我叔叔多年來一直是共和黨員。
The Republican candidate gave a speech in the city hall.
那位共和黨候選人在市政廳發表了演說。

republican.zh: 共和黨的（美國）；共和政體的
ai: The Republican Party is one of the two major parties in the United States.
共和黨是美國的兩大政黨之一。
France has a republican form of government.
法國採行共和政體。
There are twenty students in the classroom.
教室裡有二十個學生。
I will be there in twenty minutes.
我二十分鐘後到那裡。
My grandmother gave me twenty dollars for my birthday.
奶奶在我生日時給了我二十元。
The world has more than eight billion people.
全世界有超過八十億人口。
The project cost about a billion dollars.
這個計畫花了大約十億元。
Billions of stars fill our galaxy.
我們的銀河系裡有數十億顆星星。
David is a common first name in many countries.
大衛是許多國家都很常見的名字。
David and his brother play basketball every weekend.
大衛和他的哥哥每個週末都打籃球。
Our new neighbor's name is David.
我們新鄰居的名字是大衛。
Is anyone home right now?
現在有人在家嗎？
I didn't tell anyone about the surprise party.
我沒有告訴任何人那場驚喜派對的事。
Anyone can learn to swim with enough practice.
只要多練習，任何人都能學會游泳。
I made this cake myself.
這個蛋糕是我自己做的。
I looked at myself in the mirror and smiled.
我看著鏡中的自己笑了。
I live by myself in a small apartment.
我一個人住在一間小公寓裡。
The cherry blossoms are beautiful in April.
四月的櫻花很美。
My birthday is on the tenth of April.
我的生日是四月十日。
It often rains in April in Taiwan.
台灣的四月常常下雨。
School finishes in June, and summer vacation begins.
學校六月結束，暑假就開始了。
They plan to get married next June.
他們打算明年六月結婚。
The weather in June is hot and humid.
六月的天氣又熱又潮濕。
We watch TV together after dinner.
晚餐後我們一起看電視。
Please turn off the TV and go to bed.
請把電視關掉去睡覺。
They bought a big new TV for the living room.
他們為客廳買了一台新的大電視。
The movie ends at nine o'clock.
電影九點結束。
Our baby is nine months old now.
我們的寶寶現在九個月大了。
There are nine players on a baseball team.
一支棒球隊有九名球員。
You can order whatever you like on the menu.
菜單上你喜歡什麼都可以點。
Whatever happens, I will always support you.
無論發生什麼事，我都會支持你。
"Do you want pizza or noodles?" "Whatever, I don't mind."
「你要吃披薩還是麵？」「隨便啦，我都可以。」
Whatever, it doesn't matter to me.
隨便啦，我無所謂。
Scotland is the northern part of the United Kingdom.
蘇格蘭位於英國北部。
Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland.
愛丁堡是蘇格蘭的首府。
They went hiking in the mountains of Scotland last summer.
他們去年夏天到蘇格蘭的山區健行。

whom.zh: 誰（受格）；…的人（關係代名詞受格）
ai: To whom should I send this letter?
這封信我該寄給誰？
The woman whom I met yesterday is a doctor.
我昨天遇到的那位女士是醫生。
He is the friend with whom I traveled to Japan.
他就是和我一起去日本旅行的朋友。
The bakery is on Main St. near the bank.
那家麵包店在銀行附近的主街上。
Turn left at Oak St. and walk two blocks.
在橡樹街左轉，再走兩個街區。

st.zh: 聖（Saint 的縮寫，如 St. Peter）
ai: St. Patrick's Day is celebrated every March.
聖派翠克節每年三月慶祝。
We visited St. Paul's Cathedral during our trip.
我們旅行時參觀了聖保羅大教堂。
Everybody likes a free lunch.
每個人都喜歡免費的午餐。
Hello, everybody! Please take a seat.
大家好！請就座。
Everybody was surprised by the good news.
每個人都對這個好消息感到驚訝。
Peter is a common name in many countries.
彼得是許多國家都很常見的名字。
Peter and his friends play soccer after school.
彼得和他的朋友們放學後踢足球。

peter.zh: 逐漸減少、逐漸消失（peter out）
ai: The stream petered out in the dry season.
這條小溪在乾季漸漸乾涸了。
Her excitement slowly petered out as the day went on.
隨著時間過去，她的興奮感漸漸消退了。
Dr. Chen will see you in a few minutes.
陳醫師幾分鐘後就會看你的診。
Please make an appointment with Dr. Lin.
請和林醫師預約看診。
Dr. Wang gave a talk about healthy eating.
王博士做了一場關於健康飲食的演講。
The meeting starts at 3 pm.
會議下午三點開始。
The store closes at 9 pm on weekdays.
這家店平日晚上九點打烊。

pm.zh: 首相、總理（Prime Minister 的縮寫）
ai: The PM gave a speech about the new education plan.
首相發表了關於新教育計畫的演說。
The PM will meet leaders from other countries next week.
首相下週將與他國領袖會面。
France is famous for its food and wine.
法國以美食和葡萄酒聞名。
Paris is the capital of France.
巴黎是法國的首都。
They spent two weeks traveling around France.
他們花了兩個星期遊覽法國。
Is it OK if I sit here?
我坐這裡可以嗎？
The movie was OK, but not great.
這部電影還可以，但不算很棒。
My phone is working OK again after the update.
更新後我的手機又能正常運作了。
She did OK on the test, so she was relieved.
她考得還可以，所以鬆了一口氣。
We are waiting for the boss to give the OK.
我們正在等老闆點頭同意。
He got the OK to leave work early.
他獲准提早下班。
Summer vacation starts in July.
暑假從七月開始。
It is very hot and sunny in July.
七月又熱又晴朗。
We are going to the beach on the fifth of July.
我們七月五日要去海邊。
Paul is a common first name in many countries.
保羅是許多國家都很常見的名字。
Paul rides his bike to school every day.
保羅每天騎腳踏車上學。
My classmate Paul likes to draw cartoons.
我的同學保羅喜歡畫漫畫。
George is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
喬治是英語系國家很常見的名字。
George walks his dog in the park every evening.
喬治每天傍晚都在公園遛狗。
Our teacher asked George to open the window.
老師請喬治把窗戶打開。

democrat.zh: 民主黨員（美國）；民主主義者
ai: My aunt has been a Democrat since she was young.
我阿姨從年輕時就是民主黨員。
A true democrat believes everyone should have a voice.
真正的民主主義者相信每個人都應該有發言權。
The Soviet Union broke up in 1991.
蘇聯在一九九一年解體。
The museum has many old Soviet posters.
這間博物館收藏了許多舊的蘇聯海報。

soviet.zh: 蘇維埃（蘇聯時期的議會或委員會）
ai: The local soviet made decisions about the town's schools.
當地的蘇維埃負責決定這個城鎮學校的事務。
Each region sent delegates to the Supreme Soviet.
各地區都派代表前往最高蘇維埃。
Please help yourself to some tea.
請自己倒點茶喝。
You should be proud of yourself.
你應該為自己感到驕傲。
Did you make this bag yourself?
這個包包是你自己做的嗎？
The cat jumped onto the sofa.
那隻貓跳到了沙發上。
He put the heavy box onto the shelf.
他把重重的箱子放到架子上。
Please move your bag onto the floor.
請把你的包包移到地上。
Germany is a country in central Europe.
德國是位於中歐的國家。
Berlin is the capital of Germany.
柏林是德國的首都。
My friend studied engineering in Germany for two years.
我的朋友在德國念了兩年的工程。
The weather gets cooler in October.
十月的天氣開始變涼。
Our school sports day is in October.
我們學校的運動會在十月。
Halloween is on the last day of October.
萬聖節在十月的最後一天。
The new school year begins in September.
新學年從九月開始。
My sister was born in September.
我姊姊是九月出生的。
The Mid-Autumn Festival is often in September.
中秋節常常在九月。
North America includes Canada, the United States and Mexico.
北美洲包括加拿大、美國和墨西哥。
Her uncle moved to America many years ago.
她的叔叔多年前搬到了美國。
Many people in America enjoy watching baseball.
美國有很多人喜歡看棒球。
James is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
詹姆斯是英語系國家很常見的名字。
James and his cousin built a small boat together.
詹姆斯和他的表弟一起做了一艘小船。
Our new classmate's name is James.
我們新同學的名字叫詹姆斯。
The Lunar New Year often comes in January or February.
農曆新年常常在一月或二月。
It is very cold in January in northern countries.
北方國家的一月非常冷。
The new year begins on the first of January.
新的一年從一月一日開始。
We usually visit my grandparents on Sunday.
我們星期天通常會去看祖父母。
The shop is closed on Sundays.
這家店星期天不營業。
Let's meet at the park next Sunday morning.
我們下個星期天早上在公園見面吧。
Richard is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
理查德是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Richard walks to work every morning.
理查德每天早上走路上班。
My teacher asked Richard to read the next page.
老師請理查德念下一頁。
The class has thirty students.
這個班級有三十個學生。
I will be ready in thirty minutes.
我三十分鐘後準備好。
It takes about thirty minutes to get to school.
去學校大約要三十分鐘。

york.zh: 約克（英格蘭北部的歷史古城與郡）
ai: York is a historic city in northern England.
約克是英格蘭北部的一座歷史古城。
Many tourists visit York to see its old walls.
許多遊客到約克參觀古老的城牆。
We took a train from London to York.
我們從倫敦搭火車到約克。

ah.zh: 啊、哈（表示領悟、滿足或驚訝）
ai: Ah, now I understand the problem.
啊，我現在明白問題在哪了。
Ah, this hot soup feels so good on a cold day.
啊，天氣冷的時候喝熱湯真舒服。
Ah, there you are! I've been looking for you.
啊，原來你在這裡！我一直在找你。

german.zh: 德國的、德國人的、德語的
ai: She bought a German car last year.
她去年買了一輛德國車。
I am taking a German class this semester.
我這學期在上德語課。
Many Germans enjoy riding bicycles on weekends.
許多德國人週末喜歡騎腳踏車。
He speaks German and English fluently.
他的德語和英語都說得很流利。
The Scottish countryside is famous for its green hills.
蘇格蘭的鄉間以綠色丘陵聞名。
We listened to some traditional Scottish music.
我們聽了一些傳統的蘇格蘭音樂。
She has a Scottish friend who lives in Edinburgh.
她有一位住在愛丁堡的蘇格蘭朋友。
Ireland is an island country west of Britain.
愛爾蘭是位於英國西邊的島國。
Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。
The grass in Ireland stays green for most of the year.
愛爾蘭的草地一年中大部分時間都是綠的。
The book costs fifty dollars.
這本書要五十元。
My grandfather is almost fifty years old.
我的叔叔快要五十歲了。
There are about fifty people in the hall.
大廳裡大約有五十個人。
Michael is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
邁克爾是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Michael plays the guitar in a small band.
邁克爾在一個小樂團裡彈吉他。
Please ask Michael to bring some water.
請叫邁克爾帶點水來。
The days get shorter in November.
十一月白天變得比較短。
We will take a trip in November.
我們十一月要去旅行。
Her birthday is on the twentieth of November.
她的生日是十一月二十日。
Christmas is celebrated in December.
聖誕節在十二月慶祝。
It is cold and dry in December in northern Taiwan.
台灣北部的十二月又冷又乾。
The school year ends in late December for some countries.
有些國家的學期在十二月下旬結束。
Wales is one of the countries in the United Kingdom.
威爾士是英國的組成國之一。
Cardiff is the capital of Wales.
卡地夫是威爾士的首府。
We went camping in the hills of Wales last summer.
我們去年夏天到威爾士的山區露營。
Charles is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
查爾斯是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Charles reads a book before bed every night.
查爾斯每天睡前都會看書。
I sat next to Charles during the meeting.
開會時我坐在查爾斯旁邊。
My mum makes the best soup in the world.
我媽媽煮的湯是全世界最好喝的。
Mum, can I go to Tom's house after school?
媽，我放學後可以去湯姆家嗎？

mum.zh: 沉默的（keep mum 保持沉默）
ai: Everyone kept mum about the surprise party.
大家對驚喜派對的事都保持沉默。
He stayed mum when the teacher asked who broke the window.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，他一聲不吭。

senate.zh: 參議院、立法機構、評議會
ai: The Senate voted on the new law yesterday.
參議院昨天針對新法律進行了投票。
Each state elects two members to the US Senate.
每個州選出兩位美國參議員。
The university senate meets once a month.
大學評議會每個月開一次會。

ii.zh: 第二、二世（羅馬數字 2，如 World War II、Henry II）
ai: World War II ended in 1945.
第二次世界大戰在一九四五年結束。
We watched Part II of the movie last night.
我們昨晚看了這部電影的第二集。
The king was called Henry II.
那位國王被稱為亨利二世。
We decorate a tree every Christmas.
我們每年聖誕節都會裝飾一棵樹。
She bought a scarf for her mother as a Christmas gift.
她買了一條圍巾送媽媽當聖誕禮物。
The streets look beautiful at Christmas.
聖誕節時街道看起來很美。

ms.zh: 女士（Ms.，不區分已婚未婚的稱呼）
ai: Ms. Chen is the manager of our department.
陳女士是我們部門的經理。
Please send the report to Ms. Lin by Friday.
請在星期五前把報告寄給林女士。
Good morning, Ms. Wang. May I help you?
早安，王女士。需要我幫忙嗎？
We usually go hiking on Saturday.
我們星期六通常會去健行。
The party starts at seven on Saturday evening.
派對星期六晚上七點開始。
I sleep late on Saturdays.
我星期六都睡得很晚。
Smith is one of the most common last names in English.
史密斯是英語中最常見的姓氏之一。
Mr. Smith teaches science at our school.
史密斯先生在我們學校教自然科學。
The village smith made horseshoes by hand.
村裡的鐵匠用手工打造馬蹄鐵。
A skilled smith can turn a metal bar into a beautiful tool.
技藝純熟的工匠能把一根金屬棒變成漂亮的工具。

oxford.zh: 牛津（英國城市）；牛津大學
ai: Oxford is a city in England with a famous university.
牛津是英格蘭的一座城市，有一所著名的大學。
She went to Oxford to study history.
她去牛津大學念歷史。
We visited old libraries and colleges in Oxford.
我們參觀了牛津的古老圖書館和學院。

states.zh: 說明、陳述（state 的第三人稱單數）
ai: The sign states that no pets are allowed.
告示牌上說明禁止攜帶寵物。
She clearly states her opinion in every meeting.
她在每次會議上都清楚表達自己的意見。
The country is made up of fifty states.
這個國家由五十個州組成。
Water can exist in three different states.
水可以存在於三種不同的狀態。
My cousin moved to the States last year.
我表哥去年搬到了美國。
Have you ever been to the States?
你去過美國嗎？
She has a British passport.
她持有英國護照。
I enjoy watching British comedies on weekends.
我週末喜歡看英國的喜劇節目。
The British are known for drinking a lot of tea.
英國人以愛喝茶聞名。
Many British live in big cities like London.
許多英國人住在倫敦這類大城市。
February is the shortest month of the year.
二月是一年中最短的月份。
The weather is still cold in February.
二月的天氣還是很冷。
Valentine's Day is on the fourteenth of February.
情人節在二月十四日。
William is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
威廉是英語系國家很常見的名字。
William goes jogging with his dog every morning.
威廉每天早上都帶著狗去慢跑。
Our teacher called William to the front of the class.
老師叫威廉到教室前面。

am.zh: 是（be 的第一人稱單數現在式，用於 I am）
ai: I am a student at a high school in Hsinchu.
我是新竹一所高中的學生。
I am very happy to see you again.
再次見到你我非常開心。
Sorry, I am not ready yet.
抱歉，我還沒準備好。
Many Africans speak more than two languages.
許多非洲人會說兩種以上的語言。
She is an African who studies medicine in Taipei.
她是一位在台北念醫學的非洲人。
We watched a documentary about African animals.
我們看了一部關於非洲動物的紀錄片。
He loves African music and dance.
他很喜歡非洲的音樂和舞蹈。
I like Chinese tea and Chinese food.
我喜歡中國茶和中式料理。
She is learning to write Chinese characters.
她正在學寫中文字。
He speaks Chinese and English at work.
他在工作時說中文和英文。
Many Chinese celebrate the Lunar New Year with their families.
許多中國人和家人一起慶祝農曆新年。
Robert is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
羅伯特是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Robert takes the bus to work every morning.
羅伯特每天早上搭公車上班。
I borrowed a pen from Robert in class.
我在課堂上向羅伯特借了一支筆。
Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
非洲是世界上第二大的洲。
They hope to see wild animals in Africa one day.
他們希望有一天能到非洲看野生動物。
Many different languages are spoken across Africa.
整個非洲使用著許多不同的語言。
My neighbor is a Christian and goes to church on Sundays.
我的鄰居是基督徒，星期天會去教會。
Many Christians celebrate Christmas with their families.
許多基督徒和家人一起慶祝聖誕節。
The town has a small Christian church on the hill.
這個小鎮的山丘上有一間小小的基督教教堂。
She grew up in a Christian family.
她在一個基督教家庭中長大。
We bought apples, bananas, oranges, etc.
我們買了蘋果、香蕉、柳橙等等。
The store sells pens, notebooks, folders, etc.
這家店賣筆、筆記本、資料夾等等。
Please bring your ID card, phone, keys, etc.
請帶著身分證、手機、鑰匙等等。

mhm.zh: 嗯哼（表示同意或在聽對方說話）
ai: "Are you listening?" "Mhm, go on."
「你有在聽嗎？」「嗯哼，你繼續說。」
Mhm, that sounds like a good idea.
嗯哼，聽起來是個好主意。
"Did you finish your homework?" "Mhm."
「你功課寫完了嗎？」「嗯。」
Henry is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
亨利是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Henry feeds the birds in the garden every morning.
亨利每天早上都會餵花園裡的鳥。
Our teacher asked Henry to share his answer.
老師請亨利分享他的答案。
Mary is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
瑪麗是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Mary takes piano lessons every Tuesday.
瑪麗每個星期二都去上鋼琴課。
I shared my umbrella with Mary on the way home.
回家的路上我和瑪麗共撐一把傘。
My father is forty years old.
我的父親四十歲。
There are forty seats in this classroom.
這間教室有四十個座位。
The bus ride takes about forty minutes.
搭公車大約要四十分鐘。

french.zh: 法國的、法國人的、法語的
ai: She loves French bread and cheese.
她很喜歡法式麵包和起司。
We visited a French restaurant for my birthday.
我們為了慶祝我的生日去了一家法式餐廳。
She is learning French because she wants to live in Paris.
她正在學法語，因為她想住在巴黎。
The French are famous for their cooking.
法國人以烹飪聞名。
Edward is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
愛德華是英語系國家很常見的名字。
Edward plays chess with his grandfather every weekend.
愛德華每個週末都和爺爺下西洋棋。
The teacher called Edward to answer the question.
老師叫愛德華回答問題。
